classifications.internally_proven: Deterministic local fixture, memory mail, stub payment, and isolated deployment passed.
classifications.test_provider_proven: A real provider sandbox accepted the scenario without live money or customer impact.
classifications.production_smoke_tested: The production application passed a controlled, allowlisted, test-only check.
classifications.launch_blocked: The behavior must remain unavailable until its named gate is approved.

scenarios.question: What happens when a visitor submits a quote, contact, referral, campaign, or organic lead?
scenarios.expected: One assigned Drupal lead, immediate acknowledgement, Fritz alert, New stage, and a three-business-day response target.

scenarios.question: What happens if Fritz does not respond in three business days?
scenarios.expected: The protection worker marks the lead overdue, queues escalation, and exposes it on the operations dashboard.

scenarios.question: Can an unverified customer open private portal data?
scenarios.expected: No. Email verification is required before account-owned portal data or purchasing.

scenarios.question: Does a returning purchase stay with the same customer and organization?
scenarios.expected: Yes. Checkout uses the signed-in Drupal user and selected organization; orders and services remain organization-scoped.

scenarios.question: Can one customer start a website interview before purchase and later buy one or several independent websites?
scenarios.expected: Yes. Each resumable request belongs to the verified customer organization, creates a distinct lead, binds to one Commerce order, and converts into its own intake and project without exposing it to another customer.

scenarios.question: What does the $199 customer receive when they already own a domain?
scenarios.expected: Website service, one included hosting year, and domain connection; no domain-registration renewal entitlement.

scenarios.question: What does the $199 customer receive when they need a domain?
scenarios.expected: Website service, one included hosting year, and first-year standard domain registration, with annual domain renewal disclosed separately.

scenarios.question: What happens to hosting after the included first year?
scenarios.expected: It becomes $9.99 monthly only when recurring authorization was captured; failed invoices enter retry and grace before suspension.

scenarios.question: Can a mobile customer complete the real Commerce payment flow?
scenarios.expected: Yes, through Drupal Commerce and Stripe Payment Element in sandbox, producing a completed paid order.

scenarios.question: What happens when Stripe declines the card?
scenarios.expected: No paid order or entitlement is granted; the customer can retry safely.

scenarios.question: What happens when the bank requires 3DS?
scenarios.expected: Stripe presents authentication and the order completes only after a successful challenge.

scenarios.question: What records are created after payment?
scenarios.expected: Immutable deal snapshot, entitlements, customer/profile link, prospect, intake, project, portal activity, receipt, and staff alert.

scenarios.question: Does the customer receive a purchase acknowledgement?
scenarios.expected: Yes. A transactional receipt lists order, products, and intake next step.
scenarios.proof: gmail:Your FAMtastic Designs order is confirmed

scenarios.question: Does Fritz know when a sale occurs?
scenarios.expected: Yes. Fritz receives the customer, products, and order number at the configurable admin address.

scenarios.question: Can a customer create and follow support from mobile?
scenarios.expected: Yes. Portal support is mobile-safe and records a numbered, assigned case with response target and notifications.

scenarios.question: What happens when a customer replies by email?
scenarios.expected: A signed/threaded reply is matched into the support timeline; unsafe attachments are rejected and unmatched mail alerts Fritz.

scenarios.question: Can customers opt out of deals without losing service messages?
scenarios.expected: Yes. Promotional and topic preferences are separate from transactional project, billing, support, and security messages.

scenarios.question: Can one customer see another organization's data?
scenarios.expected: No. Every customer API resolves membership and organization ownership before returning resources.

scenarios.question: Can search engines discover public Drupal-driven content?
scenarios.expected: Yes. XML sitemap contains public aliases; robots advertises it and excludes account/admin/proof routes.

scenarios.question: Can Stripe report asynchronous payment and refund events securely?
scenarios.expected: Yes. The sandbox endpoint verifies a signing secret and subscribes only to supported payment/refund events.

scenarios.question: Can the system charge real customer cards right now?
scenarios.expected: No. The Commerce gateway remains in test mode and the parallel legacy payment path is disabled until an explicit live launch decision.
